verdict: Leads are arriving at a strong cost, but none are entering your pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 126 leads at $14.19 per lead — well within range — but your CRM shows zero of those leads converted into active opportunities or appointments, which points to a gap in how leads are being received and followed up internally, not a problem with the ads themselves. Ad spend held nearly flat this past week, though the cost per lead edged up 5.19% and the most recent days show a sharper drop in daily lead volume, suggesting the current audience may be starting to fatigue. On the local search side, Google Business Profile actions fell 56% week-over-week, which is worth watching as a possible early signal of softening local visibility. We're addressing the lead intake gap directly and monitoring the recent volume dip closely heading into next week.
